description: 北九州市 道路台帳数値基図 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 北九州市. 本市道路台帳基図(1/500)をディジタルマッピングにて認定道路内を数値図化したものです。 航空写真から図化された道路台帳基図((1/500、1/1000))をディジタルマッピング手法により認定道路内を数値図化したものです。 道路が更新された箇所については、現地の測量を行って合成しています。 このため、一部に現地との誤差が生じることがあり... Coverage: 北九州市. The portal files it under the publisher 北九州市. Its tags are 台帳. It offers 215 resource(s) in pdf, zip. The portal shows 2026-04-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
